summary: Reports that kept timing out now complete.

fixes.title: Timed-out reports complete in smaller parts
fixes.text: A report part that kept timing out is now asked again in smaller parts in the same run, so nothing is lost. The next run starts with smaller parts.

fixes.title: Long-incomplete reports are named
fixes.text: A report that has not been complete for several runs in a row now says so, with the date it started.
